_comment: Edit decisions for edit.mjs, trailer v2 ("Big Plays", 144 BPM: 25 frames per beat). Frame numbers are each cut's own (60 fps). The shot list is shots.mjs, the 15 s mapping is CUT15_SEGMENTS in mg-timeline.mjs, flashes/shakes/rgbashift/bumps come from post() there. Speed ramps are baked in at capture (real in-engine time scaling), so the edit never retimes footage.

grade._comment: Storyboard v2 §3: CAS 0.35; eq contrast 1.10, saturation 1.10; gentle S-curve; warm highlights; 16 % vignette; a highlight bloom (luma >= 0.82 keyed, gblur σ 18, added at 0.22) so skill FX glow on the sunny palette; grain 3. Type is composited after the grade.

chroma._comment: rgbashift. strong (4 px) = post().rgb impact frames; light (2 px) = transition accents on the whip, the match cut and the big impacts.

push._comment: Digital push-ins: none. S19 is the gameplay camera 1:1 with its full HUD; S13's wheel and S14's bark are framed natively.

bump._comment: Zoom-punch (§3): 104 % scale-in over 3 frames, then out over 8 (the impact frames in post().bump).

band._comment: §7: S27 in 9:16 is a phone in landscape (932x430 CSS px at DPR 2 = 1864x860), shown whole as a band over a blurred, darkened copy of itself.

poster._comment: Thumbnails: the Belly Flop hold (S01 f26) with the logo and end-card lines from the 30 s overlay.

audio._comment: Mix from score.mjs stems: the music ducks under the sfx + game sounds (impacts), then glue, gain to -14 LUFS, a latency-free true-peak limiter, the end fade and digital silence.
audio._tp: the WAV must measure <= maxTruePeakWavDb so the AAC encode stays <= maxTruePeakDb
audio._sections: Energy curve: [from, to, dB] with an 8-frame ramp at each end, before the glue. The gameplay body plays at full level; bar 9 steps down, the COMEBACK key lift steps up, the tower and the core impact are the loudest moments, and the end card holds the body's level (about -15 LUFS-S) with a stab on every line.
